maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from making chlor alkali, epoxy and Winchester ammunition for first-time sale and consumption, not servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Chemicals sell to industrial customers and Winchester ammunition to commercial, retail and law enforcement buyers; mostly private payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Olin grows mainly through its own chlor alkali, epoxy and Winchester operations; past acquisitions were occasional large deals, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Chlorine, caustic soda and most epoxy are commodity chemicals bought largely on price; some specialty grades are harder to switch.

notes: Mission-critical is a close call because some epoxy and specialty products may be qualified into customers' products.
